claim: Try it with sample data starts a labelled sample run in separate local storage and can be reset.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo; complete a sample run, reset it, and inspect local storage namespaces.

claim: The daily game starts immediately without an account or payment.
sandbox: Fresh context starts the daily game and makes a choice without entering account or payment details.

claim: A daily round is designed to reach its win or loss screen in two minutes or less.
sandbox: Fresh daily context makes three deterministic choices and measures the elapsed active-game time through the loss end screen.

claim: A practice run reaches a real win end screen.
sandbox: Fresh /demo run; choose all available deterministic options until the correct answer ends the run.

claim: Restart this run restores all choices and guesses.
sandbox: Complete a /demo run; restart and verify five fresh practice choices and five guesses remain.

claim: Light background, assist, garden movement, and sound settings persist in this browser.
sandbox: Set every play setting in a fresh /demo context, reload, and verify each saved value.

claim: The game has a date-based daily puzzle and open practice with five guesses.
sandbox: Fresh context opens daily mode, then starts a named practice seed and observes its five-guess state.

claim: Practice gives exactly two optional hints that reveal more traits without costing a guess.
sandbox: Fresh /demo run; request both hints, verify both added traits, no third hint action, and an unchanged guess count.

claim: The daily date and each named practice seed repeat the same habitat puzzle.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context starts the date-based daily puzzle and a named practice seed, then reloads each and compares the shown seed and field notes.

claim: Progress stays in this browser; a demo game and legal pages request only static files from this product origin.
where: First-screen facts, privacy page, and game limits
sandbox: Record all requests through the daily game, demo play, hint, settings, privacy, and terms; requests must be GETs for known static product files only.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: A new browser context visits /demo, waits for service worker control, goes offline, and reloads the game.

claim: The noninteractive visual update loop measures at least 55 FPS in the verification browser.
sandbox: Measure requestAnimationFrame callbacks for one second in a fresh /demo page.

claim: Keyboard, pointer, and touch controls activate habitat choices.
sandbox: Desktop clicks a choice then focuses another and presses Enter; the phone project taps a choice. Each action must show feedback.
